fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' hurls her crossblade in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within its path, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 40|critScaling=true}}.
fields.description2: ''Boomerang Blade's'' damage is reduced by {{pp|key=%|changedisplay=true|type=non-champions hit|0 to 60 for 5|0 to 4|formula=100%-(15%*Nº of non-champions hit). ''This is capped at 40% damage at 4 enemies hit.''}}. Upon reaching maximum range, the crossblade returns to her, resetting the damage modifier and dealing the same damage to enemies on its way back.
fields.leveling2:

fields.description3: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
fields.notes:
* Due to the cast time effectively rounding up to full game ticks, at undisturbed game tick interval times the technical minimum cast time is {{rutngt|0.1875}} reached at {{as|{{fd|99.8}}% '''bonus''' attack speed}}.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* The damage reduction per unit hit resets back to full damage upon changing direction.
* ''Boomerang Blade'' will still return to '''Sivir''' even if she dies before it changes direction.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} only blocks one instance of damage.
